verdicts.reason: Both use the same headline, set big enough to almost touch the side edges. It breaks into five ragged lines ('and a' / 'little') with a 'little' that looks orphaned, and the CTA is pushed to the bottom edge. A puts 'Now in four flavours.' right under the headline, which leaves a large dead gap above the CTA. B places the subline about midway between the headline and the button, so the vertical rhythm is more even, though the subline drifts a little away from the headline.
